feature_name: Cloud Spanner query editor multi-tab and multi-statement support
summary: The Google Cloud Console Query page for Spanner now supports multiple query tabs, allows multiple SQL/DML statements in a single tab, and lets users view per-statement results and query plans via the Results and Explanation subtabs.
